newsitems.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Update Contents 6/24
newsitems.author: denghaoyuan
newsitems.contents: [h2]- New Dolls -[/h2][p]■ Elite Doll \[Loreley][/p][p]■ Elite Doll \[Harpsy][/p][p][/p][h2]- New Weapons -[/h2][p]■ Elite Weapon \[Nighttide Nocturne][/p][p]■ Standard Weapon \[.50BMG Anti-Materiel Rifle][/p][p]■ Retired Weapon \[Retired .50BMG Anti-Materiel Rifle][/p][p]■ Elite Weapon \[Antinomy][/p][p]■ Standard Weapon \[TMP][/p][p]■ Retired Weapon \[Retired TMP][/p][p][/p][h2]- New Outfits & Skins -[/h2][p]■ Outfit \[Loreley - Twilight Whisper] and its swappable orange-quality accessories[/p][p]* After obtaining Loreley's \[Outfit - Twilight Whisper], Commander can invite Loreley to the \[Crew Deck - Dressing Room - Dressing Room Sofa] and trigger her immersive story scene[/p][p]■ Outfit \[Makiatto - Steamy Vacance] and its swappable purple-quality accessories[/p][p]* Makiatto's \[Outfit - Steamy Vacance] and its swappable accessories will be available to purchase simultaneously in the \[Outfit Boutique] and Outfit Procurement - \[Twilight Whisper][/p][p]■ Outfit \[Klukai - Indigo Oath][/p][p]* Commander who obtained this outfit will be granted free access to the vehicle component “Ivory Polestar", which can be used to replace the appearance of Klukai's heavy motorcycle.[/p][p]* Klukai's outfit - Indigo Oath comes with Lightshards that can be selected. When the Lightshards are installed, they will activate an exclusive Halo Effect and Movement Trail.[/p][p]* After obtaining the Doll \[Klukai] and her "Outfit - Indigo Oath", Commanders can watch the "Romantic Oath" performance at the \[Crew Deck] - \[Rec Room] - \[Treatment Black Box]. After watching, an exclusive Decoration \[Flawless Loop] can be obtained.[/p][p]* After the Doll \[Klukai] wears the "Outfit - Indigo Oath" in the \[Crew Deck], the daily dialogues in the \[Crew Deck] can be replaced, and Leisure Chats for the \[Crew Deck] can also be unlocked.[/p][p]■ Themed Skin Set \[Eternal Wish][/p][p]* Themed Skin Set \[Eternal Wish] has its exclusive visual effects[/p][p][/p][h2]- New Contents -[/h2][p]■ Time-Limited Event Story \[Dawnforger: Part 1]. [/p][p]・ During the event, new event stories, stages, new game mode \[Splash Bash] and game mode \[Assault Simulation] will be gradually opened. \[Heroic Mode] will be available for some stages. Commanders can receive generous rewards including \[Collapse Pieces], \[Targeted Access Permissions], and \[Access Permissions] by clearing event stages and participating in the event modes.[/p][p]* Available from June 25, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Rate Up Event \[Targeted Procurement] and \[Military Upgrade].[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Loreley] and Elite Weapon \[Nighttide Nocturne] will be increased.[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Lainie] and Elite Weapon \[Perihelion] will be increased.[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for Elite Doll \[Lewis] and Elite Weapon \[Toysmith] will be increased.[/p][p]■ Limited-Time Rate Up Event \[Custom Procurement - Dolls] and \[Custom Procurement - Weapons].[/p][p]・ During the event, the drop rate for the following selected Elite Dolls \[Vector], \[Springfield], \[Makiatto], \[Florence], \[Qiuhua], \[Klukai], and \[Belka]; Elite Weapons \[Banshee's Whisper], \[Radiance], \[Bittersweet Caramel], \[Iaso], \[Trailblazer], \[Skylla], and \[Sylvan Elf] will be increased. The first Elite drop is guaranteed to be the selected target.[/p][p]■ Added Outfit Procurement - \[Twilight Whisper] in the \[Crew Deck]. Commanders can use the \[Outfit Access Permissions] to perform accesses. Each access has a chance to yield Loreley's \[Outfit - Twilight Whisper]  and its swappable orange-quality accessories, Makiatto's \[Outfit - Steamy Vacance] and its swappable purple-quality accessories, new Weapon Skins, new Attachment Skins, new Curios and other items. You can find more details about this event in-game.[/p][p]* During the event \[Dawnforger], Commanders can obtain a total of  \[Outfit Access Permissions*30] by logging into the game, receiving in-game mails, purchasing the "Trendy Outfit Box" in the \[Shop] for free, exchanging it in the \[Furniture Shop] of the \[Crew Deck], receiving the reward of "Collect Recreation Point" in the \[Crew Deck] and other methods. [/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Event \[Evershifting Hacker]. During the event, complete tasks to receive Elite Doll \[Harpsy] for free.[/p][p]* The Elite Doll \[Harpsy] will be available to obtain in the \[Targeted Procurement], \[Custom Procurement], \[Standard Procurement], \[Beginner Procurement] and \[Exclusive Procurement], and her Weapon will be available to obtain in the \[Military Upgrade], \[Custom Procurement] and \[Standard Procurement].[/p][p]* \[Harpsy]'s Elite Weapon \[Antinomy] will be available to exchange in the \[Shop] - \[Neural Integration] after the maintenance on June 24.[/p][p]* Event \[Evershifting Hacker] will be available from June 25, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Added \[Dressing Room] in the \[Crew Deck]. After clearing up the related furniture modules, Commander can change the outfit of the Doll in the \[Renewal Wardrobe], change the outfit of Commander in the \[Wardrobe], arrange and edit the plot CG or photos on the \[Memory Wall], take photos at the \[Digital Camera], or watch the \[Dulcet Whisper] of a specific Doll on the \[Dressing Room Sofa].[/p][p]■ Added new time-limited Game Mode \[Splash Bash] on the \[Crew Deck]. Commanders can access this Game Mode through the entry in the \[Dawnforger] event interface or by going to the \[Crew Deck] - \[Mirage Terrace]. Participating in this Game Mode will unlock the new Commander's \[Outfit - Nightfire] and obtain generous rewards.[/p][p]* After the \[Dawnforger] event ends, the Commander's \[Outfit - Nightfire] and \[Portrait - Nightfire] will be available for purchase in the \[Furniture Shop] - \[Sundries]. Commander can exchange them with \[Merkle Leaves].[/p][p]■ New Game Mode \[Elmo In Bloom]. Commander can select seeds at Helena in the \[Crew Deck] and cultivate them. By watering and fertilizing daily, the flowers will bloom. Flowers can be picked and given to Helena as a hairflower, which will make her even more adorable.[/p][p]■ New Game Mode \[Culinary Creations]. Commander can add ingredients in the "Experimental Cooking" interface of \[Crew Deck] - \[Delicious Cuisine]. Invite the Doll to assist in the cooking. The Experimental Dishes are divided into Dine In and Take Out options. After Dine In, the dish effects can be immediately obtained. For Take Out, the dish can be consumed or given to the Doll in the gameplay. Giving a specific dish to the Doll can permanently enhance the Doll's certain attributes.[/p][p]* "Ingredients" and "Condiments" will start to randomly drop in the new period of Phase Clash on June 29th at 5:00 (UTC-4).[/p][p]* Some effects of Game Mode "Liminal Iteration" will be available in the future.[/p][p]■ All previous \[Stylish Outfits] and \[Outfit Box] Packages are temporarily rerun in the \[Shop] - \[Outfit Boutique].[/p][p]* Commander can receive \[Couturier Surprise Vouchers*5] in the \[Stardrop Surge] interface. Use the \[Couturier Surprise Vouchers] in the \[Shop] - \[Outfit Boutique] to purchase a non-current version's \[Stylish Outfits], \[Themed Skin Set], or \[Weapon Skin] at a discounted price. The "Couturier Surprise Vouchers" is valid until 18:59 (UTC-4) on August 5, 2026. Please pay attention.[/p][p]■ Added Loreley's \[Music Box: Bewitching Blandishments] in the \[Furniture Shop] - \[Harmonious Collection]. Commanders can unlock Loreley's \[Dreamscape] by purchasing it.[/p][p]■ Covenant and Archive unlocked for \[Loreley] and \[Harpsy]. [/p][p]■ Neural Helix System Expansion: \[Klukai].[/p][p]■ Added new Dolls \[Loreley], \[Makiatto], \[Voymastina] and \[Qiongjiu] to the \[Welcome Ceremony] in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Added new Dolls \[Loreley], \[Springfield] and \[Leva] to the \[Holography] in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Added \[Loreley] as a deployable Doll in \[Artifact Recovery - Ashen Tales].[/p][p]■ Added new Classic Drink \[Strawberry Milkshake] in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Tea Time].[/p][p]■ Added Basti's \[Private Meeting Logs] in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Commander's Hotline]: \[Total Cleanout? Ⅱ], \[Total Cleanout? Ⅲ] and \[Total Cleanout? Ⅳ].[/p][p]■ New \[Voyage Logs] are available from June 25, 9:00 (UTC-4). Added rewards \[Namecard Background - Moonlit Invitation] and \[Portrait Frame - Lunaris Nelumbo] for \[Broker's Path].[/p][p]■ Added \[Corposant: Part 1], \[Corposant: Part 1.5] and \[Corposant: Part 2] in \[Campaign].[/p][p]■ Added Weapon Skins from Past Event in \[Shop] - \[Trading Post] - \[Neural Integration].[/p][p]■ Added some furniture in \[Furniture Shop] - \[Furniture]. Added some ornaments in \[Furniture Shop] - \[Ornaments].[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Sign-In Event \[Gilded Banquet]. During the event, log in for 7 days to receive \[Targeted Access Permission ×10].[/p][p]* Available from June 25, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Event \[Elmo Special Supply]. During the event, log in to receive \[Targeted Access Permission ×10] as a reward on the event page.[/p][p]* Available from June 25, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Sign-In Event \[Inspired Cuisine]. During the event, log in to receive \[Cooking Ingredient Packs] and \[Cooking Condiment Packs].[/p][p]* Available from June 25, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Time-Limited Event \[Simulation Exercise]. During the event, clear event stages to obtain generous rewards such as \[Collapse Pieces], \[Basic Info Cores], and \[Common Key - Critical Singularity].[/p][p]* Available from July 1, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Event \[ElmoMart]. During the event, Commanders can complete daily purchase tasks or exchange \[Collapse Pieces] for "Harvest Vouchers". These "Harvest Vouchers" can be used to purchase goods from Mayling in the \[Crew Deck]. After submitting a goods order, Commanders can immediately receive the corresponding item rewards.[/p][p]* Available from July 3, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Event \[Glittering Starwish]. During the event, Commanders can gain \[Wishing Stars] by challenging \[Wishing Star Thief Z], completing daily activity missions. Spend \[Wishing Stars] and support the Doll you select to increase the rank in Leaderboard and gain rewards.[/p][p]* The top two Dolls in the previous "Glittering Starwish" events will not be available for support in the upcoming events. The Dolls that are banned from selection in this event are "Klukai" and "Leva".[/p][p]* Available from July 4, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Added Time-Limited Packages \[Gleaming Light Gift Box - Starlit Prayer], \[Flashback Cache Gift Box], \[Primeval Growth Data Pack], \[Savage Growth Data Pack], \[Trendy Outfit Box], \[Starwave Outfit Box], \[Shiny Outfit Box], \[Unfinished Gilt Gift Box] and \[Chiseled Dawn Gift Box] in \[Shop] - \[Quality Selection] - \[Treasured Gift Pack]. Added \[Moonlit Kitty Gift Box] Package on a Limited-Time Discount in \[Shop] - \[Outfit Boutique] - \[Curiosity Gallery].[/p][p][/p][h2]- Optimizations & Bug Fixes -[/h2][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic of the \[Crew Deck] - \[Holography] interface, added the \[Change Outfit] button, allowing Commanders to quickly go to the \[Renewal Wardrobe] for outfit change.[/p][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic of the \[Item Details] interface for outfit accessories, added the preview function for outfit accessories.[/p][p]■ Optimized the "Loop Assistant" function, added related Loop content such as "Platoon Rewards", "Friend Blessings", "Affinity Increase", and "Daily Commissions", optimized the related loop content of "Dispatch Room", "Targeted Study" and "Combat Exercise", optimized the automatic selection logic of the "Gunsmoke Frontline" team, and optimized some interaction logic.[/p][p]After optimization, Commander can automatically receive regular rewards such as Dispatch Room rewards, Daily Commissions rewards, Platoon Supply rewards, Friend Blessing rewards, and saved Affinity in the "Loop Assistant". At the same time, in the "Loop Assistant - Targeted Study", you can set the required Weapon Attachments and Attachment effects, and obtain Weapon Attachments according to the settings. In addition, the "Loop Assistant - Combat Exercise" supports setting the Attack Formation and can set the preference of challenging opponents with lower Combat Effectiveness.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display effect of the status of hidden supply rewards in the Event Story, added a hidden supplies obtained prompt.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display description of some Dolls' summons in the "Preparation Room". When a Doll equips an Expansion Key with the summoning effect, Commander can view the details of the corresponding summons in the \[Refitting Room] - \[Physical Summon].[/p][p]■ Optimized the performance of some animation effects in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Optimized the editing feature of Doll's outfit accessories in the \[Crew Deck], the equipped status of the selected accessories will be retained and will not reset with the change of outfit.[/p][p]■ Optimized the performance of the "Lily-White Vows" letter editing interface.[/p][p]■ Optimized features related to "Attachment Calibration". Added the "Batch Calibration" feature, optimized the display effect of the "Sardis Gold" amount in the "Extreme Calibration" interface, optimized the arrangement order of accessories in the "Replace Attachments" interface, added the "Lock Status" option in the "Filter", optimized the "Filtering" logic of Attachment attributes, and increased the number of plans for the "Attachment Lock Plan" .[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the image display in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Memory Wall] was abnormal after editing under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed certain issues with the texts.[/p][p]Notes:[/p][p]The game will be inaccessible during maintenance. Please plan your time in advance.[/p][p]If you are in a mission when maintenance begins, your progress will not be saved. Please complete your ongoing missions before the maintenance to avoid losing progress.[/p][p]The exact end time of maintenance may be delayed or earlier. Please look to our website or social media accounts for updates in case of any delays.[/p][p]Please claim your maintenance compensation from the mailbox promptly after maintenance ends. Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p][/p][p]GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM Operations Team[/p]

Added rewards \[Namecard Background - Street Art] and \[Portrait Frame - Wintry Camellia] for \[Broker's Path].[/p][p]■ Added \[Neural Migration - Silvered Whispers] in \[Past Events].[/p][p]■ Added Weapon Skins from Past Event in \[Shop] - \[Trading Post] - \[Neural Integration].[/p][p]■ New Time-Limited Event \[Broker's Rebate]. During the event, participate in Limited Procurements a certain number of times to receive additional rewards such as \[Surprise Access Permissions] and \[Universal Chain Keys].[/p][p]*\[Surprise Access Permission] can be used for all Limited-Time Procurements from 09:00 on June 25, 2026 to 18:59 on August 5, 2026 (UTC-4), including \[Targeted Procurement], \[Military Upgrade] and \[Custom Procurement]. It cannot be used before the effective period or outside the designated Procurement periods. It will become invalid after the expiration date.[/p][p]* Available from June 4, 9:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ Added Time-Limited Packages \[Vivacious Gift Box - Peach Soda] and \[Vivacious Outfit Box - Assorted Flavors] in \[Shop] - \[Quality Selection] - \[Time-Limited Package].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]- Optimizations & Bug Fixes -[/b][/h3][p]■ Fixed an issue where "Random" function was abnormal when inviting a Doll in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Delicious Cuisine] gameplay under specific circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where an abnormal issue would occur when editing Wall Decorations on the Display Wall in the \[Crew Deck] under specific circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the "Leisure Chat" of Voymastina's Outfit - \[B-ROBO Voymawari] could not be triggered in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Fixed certain issues with the texts.[/p][p][/p][p]Notes:[/p][p]The game will be inaccessible during maintenance. Please plan your time in advance.[/p][p]If you are in a mission when maintenance begins, your progress will not be saved. Please complete your ongoing missions before the maintenance to avoid losing progress.[/p][p]The exact end time of maintenance may be delayed or earlier. Please look to our website or social media accounts for updates in case of any delays.[/p][p]Please claim your maintenance compensation from the mailbox promptly after maintenance ends. Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p][/p][p]GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM Operations Team[/p]

newsitems.contents: [p][b]- New Doll -[/b][/p][p]■ Elite Doll \[Helen][/p][p][/p][p][b]- New Weapons -[/b][/p][p]■ Elite Weapon \[Dulcet Defender][/p][p]■ Standard Weapon \[SG-12][/p][p]■ Retired Weapon \[Retired SG-12][/p][p][/p][p][b]- New Outfits & Skins -[/b][/p][p]■ Outfit \[Helen - Starlit Waltz][/p][p]■ Outfit \[Leva - Sultry Tempo] and its swappable orange-quality accessories[/p][p]* After obtaining Leva's \[Outfit - Sultry Tempo], Commander can invite Leva to the \[Crew Deck - Fitness Center - Rowbike] and trigger her immersive story scene[/p][p]■ Outfit \[Dushevnaya - Tomorrow's Savior] and its swappable purple-quality accessories[/p][p]* Dushevnaya's \[Outfit -Tomorrow's Savior] and its swappable accessories will be available to purchase simultaneously in the \[Outfit Bouquet] and Outfit Procurement - \[Sultry Tempo][/p][p]■ Themed Skin Set \[Brilliant Banquet][/p][p][/p][p][b]- New Contents -[/b][/p][p]■ Time-Limited Event Story \[Antiparallel - Part 1]. You can find more details about this event in-game.[/p][p]* During the event \[Antiparallel], Commanders can obtain a total of  \[Outfit Access Permissions*30] by logging into the game, receiving in-game mails, purchasing the "Trendy Outfit Box" in the \[Shop] for free, exchanging it in the \[Furniture Store] of the \[Crew Deck], receiving the reward of "Collect Recreation Point" in the \[Crew Deck] and other methods. [/p][p]* The \[Holography] of the doll "Leva" will be updated in the future, stay tuned. [/p][p]■ Added \[Fitness Center] in the \[Crew Deck]. Commanders can exercise on the \[Multifunctional Treadmill], decorate \[Ornaments] on the \[Fitness Center Display Rack] according to your own preferences, and experience the \[Dulcet Whisper] with Leva on the \[Rowbike].[/p][p]■ Added \[Interludes] in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Blockbusters]. Commanders can review the recorded dialogues of the dolls in \[Interludes] or check the unlocking conditions of the dialogues.[/p][p]■ Added gameplay \[Soirée] in the \[Crew Deck]. Commander can participate in the gameplay in the \[Antiparallel] event interface or go to the \[Crew Deck]. Participating in the gameplay will unlock Helen's exclusive \[Dulcet Whisper] story item and obtain generous rewards.[/p][p]* Helen's exclusive \[Dulcet Whisper] story unlocked through the gameplay \[Soirée - Starlight Gala] is a single-branch storyline and does not have the feature of choosing multiple subplots. The gameplay \[Soirée - Starlight Gala] will remain open in the \[Blockbusters] after the event \[Antiparallel] ends.[/p][p]* Due to the varying playback speeds of text in different languages, Commanders may encounter incomplete display of subtitles when experiencing the story scene. [/p][p]■ Neural Helix System Expansion: \[Qiuhua].[/p][p]■ Added a new Doll \[Helen] to the \[Holography] in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Added new Dolls \[Helen] and \[Springfield] to the \[Welcome Ceremony] in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Added \[Helen] as a deployable Doll in \[Artifact Recovery - Ashen Tales].[/p][p]■ Added new Boss \[Chimera Centurion] in \[Boss Fight] - \[Crossroad Challenge].[/p][p]* Available from April 27, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p]■ New \[Voyage Logs] are available from April 23, 9:00 (UTC-4). Commanders can choose specific dolls to participate in the welcome ceremony at Meyling in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Lounge] according to your preferences and set the order of Dolls' appearance. Additionally, a skip function for the welcome ceremony has been added. Commanders can click to skip during the playback of the welcome ceremony performance.[/p][p]■ Time-Limited Event \[Simulation Exercise]. During the event, clear event stages to obtain generous rewards such as \[Collapse Pieces], \[Basic Info Cores], and \[Common Key - Brand New Agreement].[/p][p]* Available from April 8, 5:00 (UTC-4)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]- Optimizations & Bug Fixes -[/b][/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Loop Assistant] function, added the function of adjusting the loop order, added the display of intelligence puzzle consumption for each loop module, added the display of the quantity of owned items in the \[Select battle reward] interface, added the \[Menu File] jump button, and optimized the interaction logic of loop settings.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of the \[Refitting Room] - \[View Details] / \[Weapons] / \[Attachments] / \[Key Regulation] / \[Evolve] interfaces. Added the "Doll Recommendation Attribute" indicator in the \[Attribute Details] interface, and added the "Weapons/ Attachments Recommendation Attributes" indicator in the \[Weapon] and \[Attachments] interface, added the "Key Recommendation Attributes" indicator in the \[Key Regulation in] and \[Evolve] interface.[/p][p]■ Optimized the filtering function of \[Attachments], added the \[Equip Status] filter option.[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Commander's Hotline] function in the \[Crew Deck], added the unlockable doll indicator in the \[Private Meeting Logs].[/p][p]■ Optimized the battle performance effect in the stages of \[Artifact Recovery - Ashen Tales].[/p][p]■ Optimized the interface of \[Key Regulation], optimized the description text of the Key instructions.[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Settings] - \[Others] - \[Auto Battle Settings] function, removed the related settings content of \[Military Simulation].[/p][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic of the \[Shop] - \[Outfit Bouquet] interface, added the \[Stylish Outfits] and \[Curiosity Gallery] tabs, added the outfit type filtering and sorting function in the \[Stylish Outfits] interface, and added the new listing indicator in the \[Outfit Bouquet] and \[Custom Skin] interfaces.[/p][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic of the \[Shop] - \[Furniture Shop] interface, added \[Seasonal Trend] tab.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of the \[Common Key Gallery] - \[Events] interface, added the display of the common key collection status and collection quantity in the \[Events].[/p][p]■ Optimized the shortcut key settings of the \[Crew Deck], after this maintenance update, Commanders using PC devices can quickly open the \[Crew Deck Setting] interface by pressing "E" key within the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic and performance effects of the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Optimized the interface display of the \[Crew Deck] - \[Edit Mode], Commanders can view the Wall Decoration you do not own. At the same time, for the Wall Decoration that are not currently owned and are on sale in the store, they can obtain them through quick purchase.[/p][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic of the \[Storeroom], Optimized the sorting and switching logic of some items.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of the \[Exclusive Procurement] - \[Choose Doll] interface, added the display of the Segment level of the currently owned doll.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of the \[Boss Fight] - \[Crossroad Challenge], added the display of the completion status in the \[Stage Information] interface and the Settlement interface.[/p][p]■ Optimized the prompt display of the new content and unlocked content in the \[Crew Deck].[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Crew Deck Settings] option on mobile devices, added the \[Save picture to system folder] option, after enabling this setting, Commanders using mobile devices can view the photos taken in the system album.[/p][p]■ Optimized the \[Attachment Calibration] function, when Commander is calibrating the Attachments, you can hold the item to quickly increase the quantity of the item, or hold the "-" button on the item frame to quickly reduce the quantity of the item.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of the \[Combat Exercise] - \[Foe] interface, after optimization, the \[Foe] interface will display the current Portrait frame used by the opponent Commanders.[/p][p]■ Optimized the display of Dolls' Portraits in the \[Crew Deck] - \[Crimson Arcade] - \[Elmo Leaderboard].[/p][p]■ Optimized the interaction logic of the \[Dormitory].[/p][p]■ Optimized the voice performance during some dolls battles.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the outfit model of Doll "Klukai" on the mobile device would be displayed abnormally on the \[Crew Deck] under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the Doll couldn't normally apply skills on friendly units when the auto battle was enabled during combat under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the Observation Interface of the Doll on the \[Refitting Room] would be missing the \[Return] button on the mobile device under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the client would have an abnormal problem when entering the \[Refitting Room] - \[Weapons] interface when using the mobile device under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the performance scene would be abnormal when performing \[Delicious Cuisine] on the \[Crew Deck] under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the level 1 skill "Main Dancer's Aura" of the Doll "Yoohee" had an abnormal effect under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the client would have an abnormal problem when viewing \[Stage Information] in the combat stage when using the mobile device under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the pool water performance would be abnormal on the \[Crew Deck] - \[Mirage Terrace] under certain circumstances.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the battle opening performance of the enemy boss \[Fused Entropic - Beelneith] would be abnormal when using iOS mobile devices.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the \[Display Wall] editing interface on the \[Crew Deck] would have an abnormal arrangement of the same-sized wall decorations.[/p][p]■ Fixed the issue where the voices of some dolls were abnormal.[/p][p]■ Fixed certain issues with the texts.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Notes:[/p][p]The game will be inaccessible during maintenance. Please plan your time in advance.[/p][p]If you are in a mission when maintenance begins, your progress will not be saved. Please complete your ongoing missions before the maintenance to avoid losing progress.[/p][p]The exact end time of maintenance may be delayed or earlier. Please look to our website or social media accounts for updates in case of any delays.[/p][p]Please claim your maintenance compensation from the mailbox promptly after maintenance ends. Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM Operations Team[/p]

newsitems.title: [Year-End Harvest] Event Reward Distribution
newsitems.author: denghaoyuan
newsitems.contents: [p]\[Year-End Harvest] Event Reward Distribution — Outfit Self-Select Voucher[/p][p][/p][p]Commander, an Outfit Self-Select Voucher will be delivered to your in-game mailbox on January 23.[/p][p]The voucher can be used to redeem for a previously released outfit from the Outfit Boutique with an original price of 1,580 Credit Tokens or less.[/p][p][/p][p]Valid Until: December 31, 2026, 23:59 (UTC-4)[/p]

newsitems.title: Limited Event - Starry Project
newsitems.author: wuyuefan
newsitems.contents:
[p]Commanders, log in cumulatively during the event to receive Custom Gift Packs. You can choose one Elite Doll and one Elite Weapon completely FREE from the specified selection.

\[Duration]
Jan 19, 05:00 - Feb 4, 04:59 (UTC-4)[/p]
